verdict.rationale: Glama publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its MCP directory API at /api/mcp/openapi.json. It is advertised in llms.txt for client generation and discoverable through an RFC 9727 API catalog whose service-desc points at the spec. The probe 404s were on different generic paths, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: spec coverage of the Gateway (MCP-protocol proxy with no REST spec), independent or hands-on confirmation of the spec download.
